messages.content: ترجم كل وحدة إنجليزية إلى العربية الفصحى بدقة واكتمال، مع حفظ المعنى والأسماء والإشارات الكتابية. لا تضف أسماء أو معلومات غير موجودة في النص، ولا تكتب ملاحظات أو شروحاً. أخرج JSON مطابقاً للمخطط فقط. يجب أن تكون chapter وverse عددين صحيحين بأرقام 0-9، وأن يكون text_ar ترجمة الوحدة وحدها.

{"chapter":8,"verses":[{"chapter":8,"verse":6,"text":"6 So they crossed the Jordan and came to Jerusalem."},{"chapter":8,"verse":7,"text":"7 And Jeremiah and Baruch and Abimelech stood up and said: “No man married to a Babylonian may enter this city!”"},{"chapter":8,"verse":8,"text":"8 And they said to one another: “Let us get up and return to Babylon to our place.” And they departed."},{"chapter":8,"verse":9,"text":"9 But while they were coming to Babylon, the Babylonians came out to meet them, saying: “You may not enter our city, for you hated us and you left us secretly. So you cannot come in with us."},{"chapter":8,"verse":10,"text":"10 For we have taken a solemn oath together in the name of our god to receive neither you nor your children, since you left us secretly.”"}],"book_code":"4BAR"}

response_format: JSON schema with book_code and verses. Each item has integer chapter, integer verse, and Arabic text_ar. Return exactly source verse numbers 6,7,8,9,10 in this chapter.
